verdict.rationale: Conductor's core interaction model is chat-driven: users prompt agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in natural language to have them autonomously test, build, and edit repos without step-by-step confirmation (docs-17, docs-20), with messages/attachments queued and edited in a chat UI (docs-8, docs-9) and an MCP server exposing the same natural-language-driven workspace control to external clients (docs-14). Community feedback corroborates the chat-first experience, comparing its input/output feel directly to Claude Code (conductor-comm-9, conductor-comm-7). missing for 10: explicit documentation framing 'natural language commands' as a named feature, and independent hands-on proof of complex multi-step NL task execution beyond changelog snippets
